title: ReDoS: fancy-regex compiles pathological patterns without error
description: fancy_regex::Regex::new() accepts patterns like (a+)+b that cause exponential backtracking at eval time. compile() catches invalid syntax but not exponential complexity. Existing mitigation: sieve_eval_timeout_ms per-session timeout bounds worst-case CPU. Operators should set this to a reasonable value (e.g. 100ms). Full compile-time ReDoS detection would require integrating a complexity analyzer (none available in Rust without heavy deps). Acceptable as P3 deferred: timeout is sufficient for untrusted script inputs in SMTP context.
